instructions: This file keeps game-mode discovery separate from the main arena JSON files.
CurrentLobby.json still owns the selected numeric GameMode value, while this file explains what that id likely means.
Confidence is highest when the live lobby id and the live ArenaGameMode class both match the same local mapping.
Entries sourced only from local mappings are still useful, but they were not all observed in the current runtime session.
